_doc.what: Per-style lane loudness slots for the lane level stage (gain staging, #36). Overrides mix_profiles.json st_target_lufs for the listed lanes only: target = profile KICK st_target_lufs + re_kick_db. Every other lane keeps its profile target.
_doc.styles: UKMIN = ROLLER, LONG = DEEP, POP = BOUNCY, GASKIN = JACKIN (Pattern.h kStyleLabels order).
_doc.derivation: BASS re kick = measured bass_vs_kick_db p50. OTHER (stab/pluck budget) re kick = other_vs_mix - bass_vs_mix + bass_vs_kick, all p50 in one frame. STAB and PLUCK take the OTHER budget. HITS = BASS - 3 (A&R rule). PAD = BASS - 8 (PRESET_SPEC rule).
_doc.info_only: mix_lufs_i, drop_crest_db and duck_depth_db are reference numbers. The runtime does not read them: the plugin sum is a pre-master (-19 LUFS-S, -6 dBTP) and duck depth stays with the presets.
